items.title: a) Increase in pressure or decrease in volume: (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: a) Increase in pressure or decrease in volume:: a main subheading of 8.13 The effect of a change in pressure or volume, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 181-181.

blocks.text: Forward reaction mein gas ke moles 4 se 2 ho jate hain, is liye volume kam hota hai. Equilibrium par mixture shuru ke muqable kam volume leta hai. Is liye equilibrium par pressure barhane se aur ammonia banti hai, yani reaction forward taraf shift hoti hai.
